summary: U.S. GoldMining Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a board-approved extension of the term of its publicly traded warrants (exercise price $13.00) from May 1, 2026 to May 11, 2026. No other terms were changed. The warrants continue trading on Nasdaq under USGOW. This is a routine administrative action to keep the warrants exercisable before expiry, not a special situation.
